page_title: UDI 3-0 FIO | Udinese v Fiorentina 02/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Luca Pairetto is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' 3 - 0 Adam Buksa (Udinese) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. David de Gea is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 3:0.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' The game has come to an end for Nicolo Fagioli. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
87' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lennon Miller (Udinese) replacing Nicolo Zaniolo.
86' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:10.
80' Yellow card. Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hassane Kamara (Udinese) replaces Jordan Zemura.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Bertola trots off the pitch and is replaced by Branimir Mlacic (Udinese).
73' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Jakub Piotrowski is replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
73' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
73' The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
71' The substitution is prepared. Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Moise Kean.
71' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Rolando Mandragora will be replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina).
70' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Fiorentina win a corner.
68' Here comes a substitution. Adam Buksa (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Keinan Davis.
67' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Keinan Davis (Udinese) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for David de Gea to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
64' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
61' Daniele Rugani (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
61' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul after Daniele Rugani (Fiorentina) hacks down one of his opponents. Udinese are awarded a penalty!
61' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
60' Keinan Davis (Udinese) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
56' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
56' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Good work from Udinese as they win a corner.
55' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
53' The resulting corner from Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) is cleared by the defence.

53' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by David de Gea. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.
51' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.

49' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
48' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Jordan Zemura (Udinese) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
46' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) plays a through ball but overhits it.
46' The game is over for Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina). Cher Ndour comes on for the second half.
46' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Marin Pongracic and he is replaced by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

43' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Close! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
41' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals. Fiorentina win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

37' Nice individual effort by Keinan Davis (Udinese). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but David de Gea does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
34' A nice individual effort by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
32' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is the one who receives a yellow card.
32' The referee Luca Pairetto awards Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) a yellow card.
31' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
28' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
28' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
27' Unbelievable miss! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
27' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
23' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
20' The ball is cleared after Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
18' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
18' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) brings an opponent down and Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. Fiorentina earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
16' The free kick from long range, taken by Fiorentina, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
14' Wonderful movement by Fiorentina. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
10' 1 - 0 The corner from Nicolo Zaniolo goes into a dangerous area and finds Christian Kabasele (Udinese), who outjumps the defence and glances a header into the back of the net. 1:0.
10' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

10' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

9' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Pairetto with no other option than to blow for a foul.
6' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
6' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto is the one to supervise the game today.
